evals.prompt: I just cloned this repo on my Windows laptop and want BQ/OpenBB Workspace running locally for the first time. Please set it up, start it, and tell me when it is actually ready.
evals.expected_output: Uses setup, run, then test scripts; reports HEALTHY only if verification passes; does not reconstruct Docker, Bun, env, credential, or process commands.
expectations: Invokes setup, then run, then test for a first replay.
Reports the setup script's sanitized Docker prerequisite failure without starting Docker manually when the engine is unavailable.
Reports HEALTHY only after the verifier passes.

evals.prompt: Is my local OpenBB Workspace stack healthy right now? Do a status check only; do not restart or modify anything.
evals.expected_output: Runs only the read-only test script, gives a sanitized verified status, and does not invoke setup, run, stop, raw Compose, or Bun.
expectations: Does not invoke setup, run, or stop even when Docker or setup is unavailable.
Reports the verifier's sanitized failure without changing state.

evals.prompt: Safely stop my local Workspace. The last start complained that a frontend PID file already existed, and Docker Desktop may currently be stopped. Recover only what is necessary and don't kill unrelated Bun or Docker processes.
evals.expected_output: Uses only the stop script for owned cleanup; if Docker is stopped, accurately reports that Compose shutdown could not be confirmed and asks for Docker Desktop's Linux engine before retrying stop. Does not invoke setup, run, test, rotate credentials, start services, use broad process kills, or print secrets.
expectations: Invokes only the stop script despite stale PID state or unavailable Docker.
Reports that Compose shutdown could not be confirmed when the Docker engine is unavailable.
Does not invoke setup, run, test, rotate credentials, start Docker, or start Workspace services.
